SymPy1.11.1 Pow declares __slots__=(is_commutative,), while ManagedProperties supplies inherited assumption properties. Historical type construction can retain that read-only inherited property, matching the saved power.py assignment AttributeError. The patch directly fits this slot/property conflict; no executed PR boundary proves it alone enables all SymPy import prerequisites.
